lymphoid-biaised hematopoietic stems cells (Ly-HSs) are maintained in numbers in the elderly and that they efficiently generate lymphocytes in the absence of the aged environment.

lymphoid-biasted hematopoietic cells do not decline in numbers with age but instead become less efficient at producing lymphoid progeny.
